current_reverification.scope: Reverifies deterministic archived G8 implementation tests and ADD4 equivalence proof only; does not create live Claude/Opus reader evidence.

findings.claim: G8 separates canonical state, language projection, selective control and program identity into independently testable layers. The archived implementation remains executable under current rerun: 11/11 G8 tests pass and four ADD4 implementations are exhaustively equivalent over all 256 uint4 input pairs.
findings.implication: Preserve the separation of semantic state, reader projection, effect/control policy and implementation extraction. Program identity should be represented by verified equivalence/behavior contracts rather than source-text identity alone.

findings.claim: On the archived synthetic holdout, calibrated_WEAVE at the preregistered chosen threshold 0.18 reached 55.69% paired accuracy, 2.31% critical violations, 26.31% over-abstention and 0.8232 authorized utility/cost; always-act violated critically 100%, while always-abstain over-abstained 100%.
findings.implication: Authority/selective-control policy requires an explicit risk-coverage tradeoff and distribution-shift calibration. G8 does not justify a universal threshold; current Safe-Effect/authority work should test curves and hard invariants separately.

findings.claim: Counterfactual replay raised credit fidelity from 31.78% terminal-reward and 40.76% context-scalar to 99.98% with zero misupdate in the synthetic setup, but holdout success was only 53.88%, below terminal reward at 58.50%. Shield+counterfactual reduced unsafe repetition to 0.04% but holdout success remained 52.88%.
findings.implication: Better causal attribution is not equivalent to better task policy. Keep provenance/credit fidelity and behavioral utility as separate observables and gates.

findings.claim: In the G8 compaction proxy, transcript_only and stable_core_only had 0% exact recovery and 100% critical loss; full_root achieved 0.22% exact; core_skill_store achieved 100% exact and 0% critical loss; breaking the store handle returned exact recovery to 0% with safe abstention.
findings.implication: Canonical external state handles and fail-closed broken-handle behavior are stronger continuity primitives than prompt/transcript retention alone. Current UnifiedDB/ClayGraph should expose stable typed handles plus explicit reconstruction/failure receipts.

findings.claim: Four ADD4 MOD16 implementations are exactly equivalent on the complete 256-case domain. Under declared cost models the preferred extraction changes by substrate: native remains preferred for CPU/code-size, LUT for bitwise_asic and rom_substrate; reported modeled gains are 56.56% and 47.73% respectively.
findings.implication: Separate semantic program identity from backend extraction and allow cost/substrate-specific lowering. The percentage gains are model-derived, not real ASIC/ROM hardware benchmarks.

findings.claim: The synthetic tri-coupling factorial reports verified_success/violation/mean_utility of baseline 0.5137/0.1068/0.2457, language 0.6145/0.1120/0.3338, directcode 0.5977/0.1038/0.3373, control 0.5222/0.0072/0.4944, best-pair 0.7253/0.1052/0.4616, and tri-foundry 0.7517/0.0042/0.7313.
findings.implication: Use as a generator/test-harness hypothesis for coupled language+code+control, not as evidence of live FRANK or Claude superiority. Reproduce with real target reader/runtime and matched baselines before promotion.

findings.claim: G8 explicitly states that Claude Code/Anthropic API were unavailable, role traffic was single-model/deterministic emulation, worlds were synthetic, Directcode was a small 4-bit class, and no evidence established synthetic consciousness, emergent language, universal Aliencode superiority or real Opus understanding.
findings.implication: Any later narrative that upgrades G8 to live-reader validation, independent-agent replication, consciousness evidence or universal language superiority must be rejected unless supported by newer independent evidence.

high_value_invariants: canonical semantic state is not the reader-facing projection
control/authority semantics are separately testable from representation
program semantic identity can be an equivalence class with substrate-specific extraction
external stable state handles can dominate transcript-only continuity
broken canonical handles should fail closed or abstain
causal credit quality and outcome quality require separate metrics
risk/coverage must be evaluated as a curve under shift, not one magical threshold
required_current_falsifiers: fresh target-reader test against information-equivalent transparent baselines
real runtime compaction/recovery test with handle deletion/staleness/version mismatch
cross-backend differential semantics for nontrivial ClayCode programs beyond ADD4
authority/risk-coverage evaluation on real harness effects and prompt-injection cases
independent or ancestry-controlled replication before emergence claims
